title: Timesheets View OFF with Reports ON: the timesheet activities report is still available
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Timesheets View OFF, Create & Edit OFF, and Reports ON.
custom_steps:
1. Log in.
  2. Open Reports.
  3. Find the Timesheet activities report.
  4. Open it.
custom_expected: The Timesheet activities report is listed and opens, even though Timesheets View is off (this report follows the Reports page access).
